summary: Every tab in the main tab bar now shows a small icon for what it is.
details: Home, Project Instance, Project Explorer, My Workspace, Dataset View, DFM, Bornhuetter Ferguson, Cape Cod, Result Selection, Workflow, Arcode, ArcBot Guide, Browsing History, and Task Designer each have their own icon.
The icon sits at the left of the tab title and brightens on the tab you are working in.
A tab with no icon of its own shows a plain page instead, so nothing is ever blank.
